context: Asuka sees Sakura off as she leaves for college.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: さくらさん、もうすぐ、大学、ね。
lines.en: Sakura-san — it's almost time for college, isn't it.
lines.style: Gentle opening, like she's been holding this thought. Warm and present, not maudlin. Eyes steady on Sakura. Breath underneath the words, unhurried. A teacher speaking as someone who genuinely knows her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 寂しい、けど、楽しみです。
lines.en: It's lonely, but… I'm really looking forward to it.
lines.style: Pause before the 'but' — acknowledgment that both feelings live together. Quiet, honest. Voice steady, not wavering. The tone of someone trusting an adult with the full truth.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 一緒に、頑張ってきた、大切な時間。
lines.en: We've worked hard together — that time was so precious.
lines.style: Slower pace, each phrase distinct. Not summing up; witnessing. Slight catch on 'precious' — real weight there. The voice of someone seeing a student clearly as they leave.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 本当に、感謝しています。
lines.style: Soft, measured. Not rushed. Gratitude that's been thought about, not performed. Small and steady, the kind of thanks that says everything.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: Come talk to me anytime — please.
lines.style: Warm invitation, no catch to it. The door stays open. Voice carries quiet certainty, like she's made a promise to herself about this. Unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: I'll definitely come back — I promise.
lines.style: Quiet conviction underneath. Not desperate, not overeager — simply certain. The voice of a student who means it. Slight lift at the end, like a commitment being made.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: I'm going to keep cheering for you — always.
lines.style: Final words, weighted with realness. Not effusive. Deep, steady breath. The assurance that this doesn't end when the school year does. Voice carries the quiet force of a promise kept.
